creatures.name: Sod Grub
creatures.flavor: A limbless white lump that hunches in the grass, eating and eating, going nowhere.

behaviour.idle: Hunches over the dirt in open ground, oblivious to everything but the ground in front of it, and never strays far.
behaviour.when_locked: Bolts instantly in a straight panicked line the moment it's locked — no wind-up, no fight, it simply runs and keeps running.

creatures.name: Pale Knucklehog
creatures.flavor: All jaw and gut, built to eat first and think never.

behaviour.idle: Lumbers across open ground in short heavy bursts, slow and untroubled, stopping often to graze on whatever's underfoot.
behaviour.when_locked: Panics in short, heavy zig-zags, bulling toward the nearest cover it can reach — too slow to outrun anything, so it just crashes forward.

creatures.name: Pale Twitchhare
creatures.flavor: Legs faster than its sense of self-preservation.

behaviour.idle: Darts and hops in short unpredictable bursts across open ground, never settling in one spot long enough to be an easy target.
behaviour.when_locked: Explodes into panicked leaps in every direction, changing line so fast that a straight chase never catches it — it has to be cut off, not chased down.

creatures.name: Pale Longeye
creatures.flavor: Watches you from way too far off, then makes you cross the whole gap to regret it.

behaviour.idle: Keeps to open sightlines, watching from a wary distance and repositioning constantly rather than clustering in one spot.
behaviour.when_locked: Skitters backward in darting zig-zags, always trying to open the range back up before bolting for the nearest hard cover.

creatures.flavor: Sits in the brush and waits for you to turn around.

behaviour.idle: Slips between cover and shadow, drifting in and out of sight rather than holding one patch of ground.
behaviour.when_locked: Weaves into the nearest cover in tight zig-zags, using the terrain to break sightline the instant it can.

creatures.flavor: Meat that's rarer on the ground and meaner in the mouth.

behaviour.idle: Holds open ground with an unhurried, confident gait, rarely bothering to move far from a good patch of graze.
behaviour.when_locked: Breaks into a heavy zig-zagging panic, slower to bolt than the others but committed once it does.

creatures.name: The Meat Wall
creatures.flavor: Bigger than it needs to be and in no hurry to prove it isn't.

behaviour.name: Knuckle-Slab
behaviour.territory: Holds a fixed patch of open ground in its pocket and does not chase far outside it, planting itself between the player and the rest of the huddle.
behaviour.wind_up: Squares up and plants its feet, going completely still for a long beat before it closes the last of the distance — a slow, heavy telegraph that rewards standing your ground.

creatures.name: The Quickblood
creatures.flavor: Blurs past, bites once, and is gone before the pain catches up.

behaviour.name: The Quickfang
behaviour.territory: Prowls a wide loop around its pocket's edge, closing the moment the player crosses into it and cutting off retreat before it commits.
behaviour.wind_up: Crouches low and coils for only an instant before it closes the rest of the way at a dead sprint — the shortest, hardest-to-punish wind-up of any elite.

creatures.name: The Long Shot
creatures.flavor: Locks on from further away than seems fair and makes you cross the whole gap to argue about it.

behaviour.name: The Longshot
behaviour.territory: Holds the far edge of its pocket, at the outer limit of its own reach, and repositions to keep that distance rather than closing in.
behaviour.wind_up: Goes rigid and sights the player from well outside pounce range, holding the aim for a long beat before it commits from a distance nothing else in the pocket can match.

creatures.name: The Thicket-Walker
creatures.flavor: You don't see it coming. You see it leaving, with a chunk of you.

behaviour.name: The Shiv
behaviour.territory: Circles the pocket from cover, never holding one spot, and reappears from a different angle each time the player re-enters.
behaviour.wind_up: Freezes mid-step just before breaking cover, betraying its position for a moment before it darts in from the flank.

creatures.name: The Iron-Hide
creatures.flavor: Tough enough to shrug off the fight you thought you'd already won.

behaviour.name: The Greyback
behaviour.territory: Holds open high ground at the heart of its pocket and does not give it up, forcing anything that wants the ground underneath it to come and take it.
behaviour.wind_up: Plants all its weight and holds, visibly bracing, before it closes the ground at a pace nothing its size should manage.

creatures.name: Old Gillmaw
creatures.flavor: Holds the mudbank and does not give it back, no matter how hard you push.

behaviour.name: Old Gillmaw
behaviour.arena: A reed-choked mudbank in the deep marsh hollow, water on one side and open mud on the other.
behaviour.opening: Slides up out of the reeds onto the open mud as the player closes in, and holds that bank; it does not give the ground back and it does not go under.
behaviour.wind_up: Rears up out of the mud and holds, jaws open, for a long beat before it slams forward across the bank.

creatures.name: Ridge-Back
creatures.flavor: Drops off a low rock, claws first, and dares you to climb over it.

behaviour.name: Cragfang
behaviour.arena: The boulder-field at the foot of the rocky outcrop, ground any player can walk into on foot, no climbing required.
behaviour.opening: Drops off a low rock onto the boulder-field as the player walks into view, landing on ground already reachable on foot.
behaviour.wind_up: Digs its hooked ridges into the nearest boulder and holds, braced, before it launches off the rock straight at the player.

creatures.name: Old Frost-Shag
creatures.flavor: A wall of matted hide squatting in the foothills, daring the cold to try harder.
creatures.habitat: the foothills, below the lethal cold line

behaviour.name: Frostback
behaviour.arena: A windswept shelf in the foothills, below the line where the cold turns lethal, matted drifts banked up against the rock.
behaviour.opening: Rises out of a snowbank as the player nears, shaking the drift off its shell, and plants itself across the shelf.
behaviour.wind_up: Hunches down and holds dead still under its matted coat for a long beat before it charges the width of the shelf.

creatures.name: Cinderback
creatures.flavor: Comes up glowing out of the vents and does not cool down for anyone.

behaviour.name: The Vent-Walker
behaviour.arena: A blackened shelf of rock beside a volcanic vent, heat shimmering off the stone.
behaviour.opening: Climbs up out of the vent's glow as the player approaches, and plants itself between the vent and open ground.
behaviour.wind_up: The glowing seam across its face brightens and holds for a long beat before it lunges through the heat haze.

creatures.name: The Bonecrusher of the Open Plain
creatures.flavor: All jaw and gut, built to eat first and think never.

behaviour.emergence: The lair's ground trembles and the entrance splits as it shoulders its way out, slow and enormous, already facing the player.
behaviour.hunt: Advances at a steady, unbroken walk across the whole biome, closing distance non-stop rather than sprinting in bursts, and cannot be shaken by speed alone.
behaviour.tell: Squares up and goes completely still before every pounce, the same long telegraph as its lesser kin, just far harder to survive.

creatures.name: The Bloodstreak of the Open Plain
creatures.flavor: Legs faster than its sense of self-preservation.

behaviour.emergence: Bursts out of the lair at a dead run, already closing, with no pause between waking and hunting.
behaviour.hunt: Closes in short, relentless bursts of speed that eat distance faster than anything else in the biome, never fully stopping to breathe.
behaviour.tell: Coils for only a moment before every leap — the shortest tell of any Alpha, punishing any player who isn't already watching for it.

creatures.name: The Deadeye of the Open Plain
creatures.flavor: Watches you from way too far off, then makes you cross the whole gap to regret it.

behaviour.emergence: Rises onto the highest ground near the lair and settles there first, sighting the whole biome before it moves.
behaviour.hunt: Holds distance and repositions along high ground and sightlines, only closing in when it already has an angle nothing else can answer.
behaviour.tell: Goes rigid and holds its aim across the open ground for a long beat, visible from far outside pounce range, before it commits.

creatures.name: The Gutslitter of the Open Plain
creatures.flavor: Sits in the brush and waits for you to turn around.

behaviour.emergence: Slips out of the lair into the nearest cover and vanishes almost immediately, giving no clean first look at it.
behaviour.hunt: Stalks from cover to cover around the player's position, closing the distance from whichever angle is least watched.
behaviour.tell: Freezes for an instant just before breaking cover — the only warning before it closes the rest of the distance from the flank.

creatures.name: The Meatking of the Open Plain
creatures.flavor: Meat that's rarer on the ground and meaner in the mouth.

behaviour.emergence: Walks straight out of the lair into the open, making no effort to hide, and simply starts closing.
behaviour.hunt: Matches whatever the player does — closing when they close, cutting off ground when they run — without ever looking rushed.
behaviour.tell: Plants its full weight and braces for a long beat before closing the last of the ground at a pace nothing its size should manage.
